title: State Trace Rationale As Auxiliary Task in Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.36867v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose STRAT, an auxiliary task that trains deep reinforcement learning (RL) agents to predict a short textual trace of their own state. Inspired by human spatial navigation, the description combines landmark, route, and survey knowledge, tracking the agent's position, inventory, goals, and immediate progress. Environment rules generate this text online without human labelling. Our method adds a single auxiliary head to a standard policy. Across 60 sparse-reward XLand-MiniGrid tasks, STRAT solves complex environments where standard RL fails outright, while compacting state representations and preventing rank collapse. Beyond performance gains, the predicted trace provides a readable account of agent beliefs at every step for no extra cost.

translated_title: 强化学习中状态轨迹理由作为辅助任务
translated_abstract: 我们提出了STRAT，这是一种辅助任务，用于训练深度强化学习（RL）智能体预测自身状态的简短文本轨迹。受人类空间导航的启发，该描述结合了地标、路线和概览知识，追踪智能体的位置、物品库存、目标和即时进展。这些文本由环境规则在线生成，无需人工标注。我们的方法只需在标准策略上添加一个辅助输出头。在60个稀疏奖励的XLand-MiniGrid任务中，STRAT能够解决标准强化学习完全无法应对的复杂环境，同时压缩状态表示并防止秩坍缩。除了性能提升之外，预测的轨迹还以零额外成本提供了智能体在每一步信念的可读性描述。
tldr: STRAT通过让强化学习智能体预测自身状态的文本轨迹作为辅助任务，在稀疏奖励任务上显著提升性能并防止表示坍缩，同时免费提供智能体信念的可解释性描述。
en_tdlr: STRAT trains RL agents to predict a textual trace of their own state as an auxiliary task, solving complex sparse-reward environments where standard RL fails, while freely providing a readable account of agent beliefs at every step.
